item.skyabyss.gale_feather.desc: Crouch in the air to glide
item.skyabyss.gale_feather.desc2: Fades once you leave the Windbone
message.skyabyss.storm.rising_soon: A low wind growls through the bones... the storm is coming.
message.skyabyss.storm.falling_soon: A distant high cry... the storm will ease.
message.skyabyss.storm.keel_open: Three stones sing. The feather ring in the hall floor opens, and wind rises from below.
message.skyabyss.storm.stone_ringing: The wind chime stone of %s rings (%s/%s).
message.skyabyss.storm.all_rung: All three stones are singing. Something opens in the floor of the Wind Hall.
message.skyabyss.storm.return_opened: The floor nearby begins to glow. Step on it to return near the hall.
message.skyabyss.storm.trial_sleeping: This trial sleeps for now. Its stone is already singing.
message.skyabyss.storm.east_silent: The stone is silent. Something in the knob still eats the lightning.
message.skyabyss.storm.raiju_fell: The beast falls. Wind rises from the middle of the knob.
message.skyabyss.storm.bone_door_open: The rod is full. A bone door slides open.
message.skyabyss.storm.eye_open: All three receivers glow. The door to the beak opens.
message.skyabyss.storm.mirrors_reset: The mirrors turn back to how they were.
message.skyabyss.storm.mirrors_wait: The mirrors are still settling (%s s).
message.skyabyss.storm.feather_got: A gale feather drifts into your hand. Crouch in the air to glide.
message.skyabyss.storm.trials_renewed: The storm's breath changes. The trials on the back have returned.
message.skyabyss.storm.sleeping_west: The Windbone sleeps this time. Its stone already sings.
message.skyabyss.storm.sleeping_east: The Thunderbone sleeps this time. Its stone already sings.
message.skyabyss.storm.sleeping_front: The Eye Hall sleeps this time. Its stone already sings.
message.skyabyss.storm.gave_up: You let the trial go and return to the tail hall.
message.skyabyss.storm.campfire_hint: Crouch and touch the fire to give up and return to the tail hall.
message.skyabyss.storm.campfire_first: You can always crouch and touch a blue fire to give up and go back to the tail hall.
message.skyabyss.whisper.storm_tail: Beyond the feather gate, something is beating.
message.skyabyss.whisper.storm_tail_hall: A forge and a fire. The vane at the top right shows calm and storm, and how many stones sing.
message.skyabyss.whisper.storm_hub: In calm, the tower path leads up. In storm, the wind in the middle lifts you to the upper gallery.
message.skyabyss.whisper.storm_top: The wind tears past. Far ahead, the head of the great bird faces north.
message.skyabyss.whisper.storm_w0: Bones are hollow. Ride the vents; in the air, crouch to glide. Hide behind ribs when the crosswind blows.
message.skyabyss.whisper.storm_e0: When a white ring opens at your feet near a copper rod, the bolt goes to the rod.
message.skyabyss.whisper.storm_f0: The mirrors turn by hand. The lever here turns them all back.
message.skyabyss.whisper.storm_heart: Below the keel, something beats against the wind.
title.skyabyss.storm_back.sub: The wing of the thunder bird
message.skyabyss.storm.arrived: The updraft carried you onto the back of the thunder wing.
message.skyabyss.storm.leaving: You slide back down the wind to the ground.
message.skyabyss.storm.swept_back: The storm threw you back onto the bird's back.
message.skyabyss.storm.gale_hint: Ride the updraft and it will carry you up to its back.
commands.skyabyss.storm.overworld_only: The thunder wing can only be summoned in the overworld.
commands.skyabyss.storm.missing: The thunder wing is not in this world yet.
commands.skyabyss.storm.no_peak: No dry peak was found near that player.
commands.skyabyss.storm.resting: The thunder wing is coming down to rest on a peak.
commands.skyabyss.storm.status_absent: Thunder wing not present (spawned before: %s). Storm window in %s s.
commands.skyabyss.storm.status: Thunder wing: %s at %s, %s, %s. Storm window in %s s.
